releases.name: opencode-copilot-statusline 1.2.0
releases.body:
### Changed

- Adapt the statusline to the terminal width: the reset countdown shows at 120+ columns and the account label is dropped below 80; expanding the footer details no longer forces the countdown.

<details>
<summary>简体中文</summary>

### 变更

- 按终端宽度调整状态栏：≥ 120 列显示重置倒计时，< 80 列隐藏账号标签；展开底栏详情不再强制显示倒计时。

</details>

**Changelog**: Read [here](https://github.com/lnwu/opencode-statusline-plugins/blob/opencode-copilot-statusline%401.2.0/packages/opencode-copilot-statusline/CHANGELOG.md)
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lnwu/opencode-statusline-plugins/compare/opencode-copilot-statusline%401.1.1...opencode-copilot-statusline%401.2.0

releases.name: opencode-copilot-statusline 1.1.1
releases.body:
### Changed

- Show the account label only when several GitHub Copilot accounts are connected; a single account keeps the plain `Copilot` title.

<details>
<summary>简体中文</summary>

### 变更

- 仅在连接多个 GitHub Copilot 账号时显示账号标签；只有一个账号时保持纯 `Copilot` 标题。

</details>

**Changelog**: Read [here](https://github.com/lnwu/opencode-statusline-plugins/blob/opencode-copilot-statusline%401.1.1/packages/opencode-copilot-statusline/CHANGELOG.md)
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lnwu/opencode-statusline-plugins/compare/opencode-copilot-statusline%401.1.0...opencode-copilot-statusline%401.1.1
